import numpy as np
from scipy import signal


def moving_average(series, window):
    """Compute centered moving average."""
    kernel = np.ones(window) / window
    ma = np.convolve(series, kernel, mode='same')
    return ma


def decompose_additive(series, period):
    """Additive seasonal decomposition: Y = Trend + Seasonal + Residual."""
    trend = moving_average(series, period)
    detrended = series - trend
    
    n_seasons = len(detrended) // period
    seasonal = np.zeros(len(series))
    for i in range(period):
        indices = list(range(i, len(detrended), period))
        seasonal_val = np.mean([detrended[j] for j in indices if j < len(detrended)])
        seasonal[i::period] = seasonal_val
    
    seasonal = seasonal - np.mean(seasonal)
    residual = series - trend - seasonal
    
    return trend, seasonal, residual


def decompose_multiplicative(series, period):
    """Multiplicative seasonal decomposition: Y = Trend * Seasonal * Residual."""
    trend = moving_average(series, period)
    trend = np.where(trend == 0, 1e-10, trend)
    
    detrended = series / trend
    
    n_seasons = len(detrended) // period
    seasonal = np.ones(len(series))
    for i in range(period):
        indices = list(range(i, len(detrended), period))
        seasonal_val = np.mean([detrended[j] for j in indices if j < len(detrended)])
        seasonal[i::period] = seasonal_val
    
    seasonal = seasonal / np.mean(seasonal)
    residual = series / (trend * seasonal)
    
    return trend, seasonal, residual


def reconstruct_series(trend, seasonal, residual, mode='additive'):
    """Reconstruct original series from components."""
    if mode == 'additive':
        return trend + seasonal + residual
    else:
        return trend * seasonal * residual
